name: Shenzhou 13 Guidao Cang
about: Shenzhou 13 Guidao Cang (2021-092C), a crewed vehicle (Shenzhou OM), launched 2021 Oct 15. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (R).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2022 Apr 20), held fixed
